name: Shareate Tools Ltd.
summary: Shareate Tools Ltd., a manufacturer based in Suzhou, China, specializes in the production and distribution of advanced drilling implements and cemented carbide products. Its extensive product line encompasses a variety of rock drilling solutions, including rotary and tri-cone bits, water well bits, and down-the-hole (DTH) hammers with their corresponding bits. The company also supplies numerous tungsten carbide items specifically for mining applications, such as inserts, substrates, shield machine tools, coal cutter picks, and tungsten carbide tubular electrodes. Further offerings include precision components, diverse cutting tools, and a selection of tungsten carbide die products like plates, cold headings, hobs, and powder metallurgy dies, in addition to cermet materials. These specialized tools and materials cater to a broad spectrum of industries, including mining, oil and gas exploration, metalworking, petroleum, aerospace, electronics, maritime construction, chemical processing, textiles, and machinery manufacturing. Shareate Tools extends its reach globally, exporting products to regions such as South America, Africa, Australia, Russia, South Korea, the United States, and Canada. Established in 1973, the company adopted its current name, Shareate Tools Ltd., in May 2012, having previously operated as Kingdream Shareate Tools Ltd.
